module_summary: Serial-triggered timer: FSM detects 1101, shifts in a 4-bit delay, counts (delay+1)*1000 cycles with a fast 0-999 counter and a decrementing delay register, then waits for ack.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Controller: pattern search, 4 shift states, Count, Wait for ack

anchors.name: scount
anchors.why: Delay shift register, then decrementing remaining-time counter

anchors.name: fcount
anchors.why: Fast 0-999 cycle counter pacing scount decrements

anchors.name: done_counting
anchors.why: Terminal condition moving FSM from Count to Wait

anchors.name: shift_ena
anchors.why: Enables shifting data bits into scount in B0-B3

anchors.name: counting
anchors.why: Count-state indication; enables counters and count output

anchors.name: done
anchors.why: Timeout indication asserted in Wait state

anchors.name: count
anchors.why: Remaining time output from scount while counting

anchors.name: ack
anchors.why: User acknowledge returning FSM from Wait to search

anchors.name: data
anchors.why: Serial input for pattern detection and delay bits

groups.name: Timer controller
groups.description: Pattern detect, delay shift, count and wait sequencing

groups.name: Serial input
groups.description: Serial data bits feeding detector and delay shift
